Bounded fill tool and paint-core implementations have explicit owning-module registrations.

Tool, shared editor and reversible compact adapter replace duplicate legacy tool/editor/helper TUs. Full control/type equivalence remains under their existing feature tasks.

Layer tiles use registered C++ and canonical custom-layer editors. Full legacy popup/type acceptance remains separate.

Shared editor, native GTK3 popovers and compact controls are registered replacements; old helper/type contracts remain in their separate WBS/source obligations.
